title: A spinner can turn about the middle of the artboard
goal: A rotation can turn a shape about its own centre or its top or bottom, but not about the artboard, so a spinner arc that is not centred in its frame orbits instead of spinning, and dragging the pivot does not snap to the middle. The loop walkthrough picks Artboard from the Around row in one click.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-loop-wt.html step 4 'the Around row, and choose Artboard', crosshair at 12,12. Code: pivot stored relative to the layer box, named spots only Its centre/Top centre/Bottom centre in Sources/PhotonzCore/LayerMotion.swift ~574-596; menu Sources/Photonz/MotionListInspector.swift ~491; pivot drag has no snapping, Sources/Photonz/CanvasMotionPivot.swift ~219-228. SVG export: Sources/PhotonzCore/SVGMotionExport.swift. Tests first in core.
acceptance: On an icon frame at Next defaults, the Rotation's Around row offers Artboard, and picking it turns the layer about the frame's centre
Dragging the pivot on the canvas snaps to the frame centre and to the shape's own centre
An exported animated SVG turns about the same point as the canvas
A walk adds Rotation to an off-centre arc, picks Artboard, and runs green at Next defaults

Audit written under queue/audits/ with the canvas beside icon-loop-wt.html step 4; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: review before building: a Premiere/AE or Figma user expects an anchor point they can put on the artboard centre; storing Artboard as a fraction of the arc's box would drift off the icon's middle the moment the arc is nudged or reshaped, so Artboard is a fixed place in the layer's parent space (MotionPivot.artboard), named in the menu, never Custom. Offered only inside icon frames (PhotonzDocument.artboardPivot), matching the mock.

also fixed: the pivot handle was built from the layer's frame-relative numbers and handed to the canvas as canvas points, so for a shape inside any frame the crosshair (and its drag) would sit at the frame-relative spot on the canvas. Read from code (EditorState.motionPivotHandle used document.layer(id:) with no parentOrigin), not reproduced on the old build; every earlier pivot walk used loose shapes. Handle now carries the parent origin; At row still reads frame units (12, 12).

drag snap: MotionPivot.dragged pulls onto the icon's middle and the shape's own middle within IconSnap.pullRadius screen points; the nearer wins, a tie goes to the shape. This applies to loose shapes too (snap to own centre). onMotionPivotMove now returns where the pivot landed so the crosshair shows the pull.

tests: full Scripts/test.sh hung twice in system HEIF/Vision/AVAssetReader work (sampled), unrelated to this change; ran it split instead: --skip 'PhotonzRenderTests|PhotonzMediaTests' 11003 pass, and those two targets alone 1223 pass. Filed find-out-why-the-whole-test-run-hangs-in-the-mac (p2). Walks: spinner-turns-about-the-artboard-walk plus 9 pivot/motion walks all ok.

left rough (no task): Artboard is not offered on screen frames; resizing the icon after picking Artboard leaves the pivot on the old middle; the blue 'pivot' label over a red shape is hard to read in 1-turns-about-its-own-middle (pre-existing, accent on the shape's fill). Filed a-ring-or-arc-gets-a-full-turn-forever-when-rota for the mock's 0 to 360 Forever default.

Around offers Artboard inside icon frames (fixed place, turns about 12,12; SVG matches); crosshair drag pulls onto the icon's and the shape's middle; crosshair now right for shapes in frames. ArtboardPivotTests; walk spinner-turns-about-the-artboard-walk green at Next defaults plus 9 pivot walks; suite run in two green parts after a system HEIF/Vision hang.
